objections.objection: Record bundles layer adjustment 0.45->0.2 and iterations 30->35 as one intervention, so it does not isolate which resolved the 20k DRCs at 0.24 density. Both were tried together per quote, leaving macro-loop hypothesis from #5971 as unresolved confounder.

mechanism_check: Plausible if layer adjustment semantics are 0.2 = less capacity reduction than 0.45, as thread prose implies. Increasing available track capacity plus increasing congestion iterations from 30 to 35 could allow GRT to converge despite low 0.24 density and top/macro hotspot. Causal chain breaks on attribution: macro-looping-around-macro cause from #5971 is deferred, not excluded, so post_state could also reflect workaround rather than root-cause fix.
evidence_check: post_state is asserted not measured. Record only reports phrases 'could finish GRT' and 'complete BoomTile' after the change. No re-measured DRC count, no runtime, no GRT log, no PR/commit link. Issue later auto-closed as not_planned/Stale in 2026, with gaps explicitly noting no measured post-fix count and no merge evidence. This is evidence defect, not mechanism defect.
attribution_check: SOUND. direct_quote text 'we could finish GRT by changing the routing layer adjustments from 0.45 to 0.2.' is attributed to named participant eder-matheus with date 2024-11-14 and locator URL, and it directly supports chosen_intervention's layer-adjustment claim. Second sentence about 35 iterations in chosen_intervention is not in quote but is consistent with candidates_considered sweep.

Whether 0.45->0.2 and 30->35 were merged as code change or just local config override
Outcome of macro-loop root cause in #5971 that is cited as separate suspected cause
